label: 01 · Direct ports
description: The first translation: same Claude agents, same workflow intent, explicit API differences.
validation: All 26 ports typecheck under the batch’s migration settings. 67 deterministic scenarios matched original prompts and outputs; an interrupted pipeline also resumed from checkpoints (68 checks total). No live Claude agents were run; fixtures do not establish agent quality or exhaustive equivalence.
commonChanges: agent(prompt, options) becomes an explicit ctx.claude.object or ctx.claude.text call with a durable ID, followed by result.output. JSON Schemas become Zod schemas; their field descriptions and optional properties are retained.

Phase titles remain as metadata and stderr messages. Quiet Choir has no native phase timeline. Per-call effort has no ClaudeOptions equivalent and is recorded as a comment, not silently mapped to a different model.

Legacy fan-out helpers use ctx.map with eight concurrent items per group and isolated ID scopes. Bug-hunt uses runtime named maps and ctx.within with semantic leaf IDs instead of the counter allocator. Pipelines still advance each item independently. This is not the original harness-wide concurrency ceiling; nested groups can exceed eight agents.

Quiet Choir propagates agent failures and drains started mappers without cancellation by default; the original harness returns null and continues. These ports stop scheduling after a failure and can be explicitly resumed. Completed effects replay by ID, not by an unchanged prefix of agent calls.

Fresh headless Claude sessions do not inherit the interactive conversation's permissions, model, or effort. The $claude input exposes model, tools, allowedTools, turns, timeout, and per-call USD limit. Defaults here are 40 turns, ten minutes, and $5 per call; tools remain disabled unless explicitly enabled.

Final results omit undefined object properties and turn undefined array elements into null to match JavaScript JSON transport. The final output schema checks JSON compatibility; agent response schemas are specific. This initial migration uses permissive TypeScript settings for legacy orchestration locals.

apiSnapshot.description: Scoped-ID API used by the active bug-hunt port at quiet-choir commit 5b3717404a160575135de831215e215e13c9d2aa. Other ports retain supported legacy overloads. The hash identifies this model file; the regression suite tests the current built checkout.
